checks.detail: Unified source and actual started receipt use hepta.hia.unified-qualification.v4.
All 12 reviewed files match frozen b92141483ca5084691f436d28d4cd0dcbefe4717 Git bytes.
AST-inspected plan has exactly 35 unique gate names; actual started receipt matches the ordered plan.
application_performance and standalone_performance are the last two declared gates.
Git failures, dirty/untracked visible files and non-allowlisted ignored implementation inputs reject before the output directory is created.
Only build-provenance.json and the upstream/ export are allowed as additional local dependency inputs; all 117 actual additional input hashes currently match the started receipt.
Only the exact two Cargo output-root prefixes are newly excluded; arbitrary source directories named target remain included, with a protocol regression.
Source files use bounded ordinary inode hashing, no-follow/nonblocking open and before/during/after identity checks; historical generated-path exclusions remain explicit in source.
Unified completion requires before/after source snapshot equality; a snapshot exception prevents qualification.
Initial discovery refuses loader errors, an empty inventory, duplicate IDs and module-name escapes.
Every discovered module is scheduled once, descending case count with alphabetical ties, with two worker threads and retries=0 in the declared plan.
Child test runner records start and finish IDs and exact unittest counts; setup errors, skips, expected failures and unexpected successes prevent success.
validate_report requires independently supplied expected_ids; the unified caller obtains them through fresh source discovery, not the submitted report.
Regression removes a complete module, its IDs and adjusted aggregate counts/hash and requires rejection against independent expected_ids.
Replay now requires exact total tests, completed/expected/passed module counts, no failed modules, workers=2, single_process_full_suite=false, passed=true per module and exact sorted expected_ids.
Child and aggregate intake uses strict duplicate-key and literal NaN/Infinity rejection; rehashed child duplicate/nonfinite controls are present.
Replay requires module-specific basenames, stable regular bounded receipt/log reads and exact SHA-256/size binding, including zero-byte stdout.
Module qualification requires actual zero process exit, no capture rejection, completed child status and matching successful nonempty terminal unittest summary.
600-second child budget is polled at test starts and bounded-tool polls, and scope exit marks late completion; nesting cannot extend parent deadlines.
Parent retains bounded partial output and fails the module on its separate 900-second process-group timeout; no preemptive whole-tree guarantee is claimed.
Unified coordinator invokes module scheduling directly and does not impose the historical 1800-second aggregate kill on the full unit inventory.
Imported hosted/native gates call their existing validators and require actual zero producer exit; success flags alone are covered by negative controls.
Plan/started records are written before execution and each completed unified gate gets an exclusive checkpoint; module logs/results/progress files are also exclusive.
Unified catches interruption for final incomplete reporting, restores environment/cwd, attempts a post-run snapshot and rethrows; retained checkpoints cannot produce a full pass.
full_six_deliverables_complete and full_seven_deliverables_complete remain false independently of finite gate success.
37 methods across the four reviewed protocol modules were inspected in source; this audit did not execute them or count them as current-run passes.

limits: This is a source audit; the full 35-gate run was still active and its eventual results are not credited here.
A frozen before/after source digest is point-in-time identity, not continuous tamper detection or remote host/toolchain attestation.
Local producer code, Python unittest behavior and the local filesystem remain trusted. An operator able to fabricate all receipts/logs is outside this validation model.
The unit guarantee is a module-partitioned exact-ID matrix, not a single-process suite and not representative Agent productivity.
The 600-second deadline is cooperative. The 900-second module timeout and other bounded commands clean POSIX process groups but do not guarantee cleanup of descendants that create new sessions.
Generated Cargo outputs are excluded from source snapshots; selected compiler/evaluator identities require their separate executable/build provenance evidence.
117 separately inventoried NDU dependency inputs are not files in the Hepta commit; their hashes were checked without certifying private upstream implementation correctness.
Module/test counts are method-ID counts; subtests and native/resource observations require separate explicitly scoped denominators.
Protocol regressions include synthetic control-flow fixtures. Their presence or later pass does not substitute for actual native/platform/performance qualification.

prior_findings.evidence: required expected_ids parameter, fresh discovery in unified caller, complete-module deletion negative in test_hia_partitioned_unit.py
aggregate and per-module summary consistency checks plus negative mutations in test_hia_partitioned_unit.py

review_method: Read-only source/control-flow inspection, AST plan extraction, Git-byte comparisons and dependency hash rereads. No tests, benchmarks, compilers, process signals or repository writes.
